items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: It was the same thing Stuff Smith was playing. Oh really? He's not as good as Stuff though, is he? Ah, no. But he's still playing. He's just recorded. With Jay McShann. Yes. I don't think he was as good as Stuff, but he was very good.

ctx.x: : Well, this band which left Kansas City consisted of what? Of Lester, Herschel, (Coughy) Roberts?
